$comment: Misconception catalogue. 'implicates' lists skills whose weakness this misconception is evidence of; the detour planner (src/engine/planner.ts) intersects it with the prerequisite closure of the failed skill. Awaiting named human review with the templates that use these tags.

misconceptions.description: Uses run over rise for a slope.
Gets the sign of the y-intercept wrong.

flashcard.front: y = mx + c: where does the line cross the y-axis?

misconceptions.description: Uses equal slopes for perpendicular lines.
Flips a slope for a perpendicular line but keeps its sign.

flashcard.front: A line has slope 2/3. Slope of a perpendicular line?

misconceptions.description: Negates a slope for a perpendicular line without flipping it.

flashcard.front: Is the perpendicular slope to m just −m?

misconceptions.description: Omits the modulus in the angle-between-lines formula, giving the obtuse angle.

flashcard.front: Why the modulus in tan θ = |(m₂ − m₁)/(1 + m₁m₂)|?
flashcard.back: Without it you may get the obtuse angle's tangent (negative).

misconceptions.description: Uses 1 − m₁m₂ in the angle-between-lines formula.
Reads the slope of Ax + By + C = 0 as A/B.
Omits √(A² + B²) from a distance formula.

flashcard.front: Distance between Ax + By + C₁ = 0 and Ax + By + C₂ = 0?

misconceptions.description: Divides by A² + B² instead of its square root.

flashcard.front: Denominator in the point–line distance formula?

misconceptions.description: Adds the constants instead of subtracting them.

flashcard.back: |C₁ − C₂|, with both equations in the same form.

misconceptions.description: Writes x − y = a for equal intercepts.

flashcard.front: A line with equal intercepts a on both axes?

misconceptions.description: Uses a point's coordinates as the line's intercepts.

flashcard.front: Is a point on a line the same as its intercepts?
flashcard.back: No: intercepts are where the line cuts the axes.
